2026 Board Meetings

2026 Board Meetings

Board of Education meetings are typically held on the first and third Wednesdays of each month and begin at 6:00 p.m., unless otherwise specified in the event listing below. Regular Board of Education meetings are held at 395 S. Pratt Parkway in Longmont and are live-streamed at https://stvra.in/boemeetings.

Study Sessions are also held at 395 S. Pratt Parkway in Longmont and are typically scheduled for the third Wednesday of each month and begin at 6:00 p.m., unless otherwise specified in the event listing below.
